cases.name: Studio and lab share a manual-camera default
A new renderer never enables follow implicitly
Ordinary progress updates keep manual mode
An explicit enable requests an immediate fit even when paused
First manual input interrupts follow and signals UI exactly once
Stale enabled props cannot override the manual camera for later frames
Acknowledging off does not itself resume follow
Only an explicit off/on transition re-arms follow
Manual input while already in manual mode is idempotent
Explicitly disabling follow preserves manual ownership
